title: Draw Steel: Battle Log
description: Draws the shape of a fight into the chat log: every turn, round and encounter bracketed by a marker you can fold away. Fits the default Draw Steel chat cards to the Foundry dark theme, and lets you collapse an ability card down to its name by clicking it.

conflicts.reason: Both restyle the same chat cards. They run side by side, but the two looks can fight, and matching them is not planned.
